outcome: Mode of delivery (elective caesarean, emergency caesarean)
cohort: 10,144 singleton pregnancies resulting in live births between 2014 and 2020 in Australia and New Zealand
finding: Significant variation was observed in the management of maternal hyperglycaemia and pregnancy outcomes across different diabetes services in Australia and New Zealand.
mod_finding: Rates of elective caesarean section ranged from 3.6% to 23.7% and emergency caesarean section ranged from 3.5% to 21.2% among women with GDM.
